issues.problem: NVIDIA's net income for fiscal 2024 was about $29.8 billion ($29,760M), not $37.2 billion. Net income can't plausibly be higher than the stated operating income of $33.0 billion here.

data.summary: The analysis is not accurate. The net income figure is wrong: NVIDIA earned about $29.8 billion in fiscal 2024, not $37.2 billion. The other figures check out against my knowledge of the company's results: revenue of $60.9 billion, up 125.9% from $27.0 billion, operating income of about $33.0 billion, total assets of $65.7 billion and cash and cash equivalents of $7.3 billion.
